title: The precheck's changed-tests step has a fixed 230 s cap
what: Replace the precheck changed-tests step's fixed 230 s cap with a hang bound that a loaded machine passes (the 600 s polled bound the gate tests use) or a budget derived from the work; extend tests/test_hang_limits.py to cover it.
why: 29 Oct: relay precheck went red only on its 'changed tests took longer than 230 s' step at load 17-35 on 12 cores, twice in one day (wt/queue-time-estimates-are-guesses-with-no, wt/tests-with-a-fixed-time-limit-fail-on-a); the same 16 changed test files pass in 199 s at load 8 (364 passed). It is the fixed-wall-clock class of tests-with-a-fixed-time-limit-fail-on-a-loaded-m, in lib code outside that change's files. Each such red stops a worker's quiet loop and found nothing wrong.
failing_case: relay precheck in a worktree whose 16 changed test files take 240 s at load 32 goes red on 'changed tests took longer than 230 s' though every test passed.
pass_cases: changed tests that pass in 240 s at load 32 leave the precheck green
a changed test that hangs is still stopped and reported, within the hang bound
tests/test_hang_limits.py flags a fixed 230 s cap if it comes back
